name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-06-04, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.80 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
